description: This Java source file defines the ResourceBundleMapWrapper class, which allows a ResourceBundle to be used as a Map interface. It includes methods for managing resource bundle stacks, retrieving localized strings with expansion, and handling resource bundle layering. The class also contains an inner class, InternalRbmWrapper, for managing individual resource bundles within the stack.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper that allows using ResourceBundles as a Map, supporting stack-based layering of resource bundles and string expansion within localized values.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper.InternalRbmWrapper
classes.description: An internal class that wraps a ResourceBundle and exposes it as a Map, managing lazy map creation and resource bundle reference.

methods.name: addBottomResourceBundle
methods.description: Adds a resource bundle or its wrapper to the bottom of the stack, optionally creating from resource name.

methods.name: pushResourceBundle
methods.description: Pushes a resource bundle wrapper onto the top of the stack, which overrides lower layers.

methods.name: getInitialResourceBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the initial (base) resource bundle used to initialize the wrapper.
